plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Westermo switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 16177).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_load
metrics.description: 1-minute CPU load average of the Westermo WeOS switch (WESTERMO-WEOS-MIB loadAvg1 at 1.3.6.1.4.1.16177.2.1.5.3.2.1.0). The device reports load×100 (for example 150 means 1.50), not a 0–100 percent; the query divides by 100 so the dashboard shows the load average.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load5
metrics.description: 5-minute CPU load average of the Westermo WeOS switch (WESTERMO-WEOS-MIB loadAvg5 at 1.3.6.1.4.1.16177.2.1.5.3.2.2.0). The device reports load×100; the query divides by 100.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load15
metrics.description: 15-minute CPU load average of the Westermo WeOS switch (WESTERMO-WEOS-MIB loadAvg15 at 1.3.6.1.4.1.16177.2.1.5.3.2.3.0). The device reports load×100; the query divides by 100.

metrics.name: device_memory_available
metrics.description: Available memory of the Westermo WeOS switch in bytes (WESTERMO-WEOS-MIB memoryAvail at 1.3.6.1.4.1.16177.2.1.5.3.1.0, reported in KB and converted ×1024). WeOS does not expose used or total memory scalars; used/free/usage are not fabricated.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
